'''Athallia''' was an astronomical object<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> located in the [[Athallia system/Legends|Athallia system]]. It was a part of the [[Athallia sector/Legends|Athallia sector]],<ref name="EAOC" /> within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing Sectors" /> the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]].<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Kalarcha]] served as Athallia's [[Capital/Legends|capital]].<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> Athallia shared its name with the [[Courier/Legends|courier]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Athallian Messenger]]''.<ref name="Galaxy9">{{GalaxyCite|9|Wanderer of Worlds}}</ref>

The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Fin Mak'lath]] [[Homeworld/Legends|hailed]] from Athallia, and served as a [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] in Kalarcha. When [[Fin Mak'lath's wife|Mak'lath's wife]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] riots<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> at some point by [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Date">{{InsiderCite|148|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: The Cloud City Wing Guards}} states [[Fin Mak'lath]] moved to [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]] and became a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] after [[Fin Mak'lath's wife|his wife]] was [[Death/Legends|killed]] on Athallia. "Rogues Gallery" also depicts Mak'lath serving in the ranks of the Wing Guard during the events of [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']], which ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates to [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Therefore, Mak'lath's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] must have perished at some point by 3 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]].</ref> the widowed policeman moved to<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Bespin/Legends|Bespin]], where he eventually became a member of the [[Bespin Wing Guard/Legends|Bespin Wing Guard]] [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|security force]].<ref name="RoguesGallery" />

==Behind the scenes==
Athallia was first mentioned in the "[[Rogues Gallery (department)|Rogues Gallery]]" department within the [[Star Wars Insider 148|one-hundred-forty-eighth issue]] of the ''[[Star Wars Insider]]'' magazine,<ref name="RoguesGallery" /> which was released on [[March 11]], [[2014]].<ref name="Titan">{{TitanMagazines|url=t/star-wars-insider/us/148|text=Star Wars Insider Issue #148}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Athallia [[Star system/Legends|system]], and therefore the celestial body Athallia, within grid square M-15.<ref name="TEA" />
